prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW Simple Steps quest illustration for Exploritaire. Reference image 1 (approved Find a way out watercolor) is the authoritative brushwork/night palette reference; reference image 2 is Hero's face/identity reference ONLY, do not copy its fine detail or daytime lighting. NOT the rejected realistic rendering. ART DIRECTION: broad merged wet watercolor washes, selective ink accents, varied lost/soft/hard edges, saturated identity colors and readable silhouettes. A small number of large irregular brush dabs and merged pigment masses, wet-on-wet diffusion, diluted feathering and occasional pooled pigment boundaries. Grain supports paint, never replaces brushwork. Decisively simplify foliage, stone and fur; no individual hairs, no tiny leaf veins, no stipple, gritty photographic stone, mosaic flecks, engraved textures, digital gloss or photorealism. COMPOSITION: square full-bleed artwork, no card frame or lettering. Camera perched directly ABOVE the entrance of a small rocky den, looking steeply DOWN over its upper stone lip toward the dirt immediately outside. Hero peeks inquisitively outward and slightly upward from beneath the stone lip: show ONLY her head and ears, her body and paws hidden in the den. She is the approved tricolor Australian Shepherd from reference 2, charcoal/slate head, warm copper eyebrows and cheeks, broad cream/white blaze and muzzle, amber curious eyes, floppy-tipped asymmetrical large ears; not a corgi, not a fox. Friendly thoughtful curiosity, slight head tilt. Surround her with just a few broad gray-blue rock masses and an ochre dirt wash. Moonlit indigo/cobalt night with cool cyan reflected light as in reference1. No moon disk, no stars overlay on foreground, no berries or other animals. The result must clearly look like loose hand-painted watercolor at card size, not a detailed photograph with watercolor texture.
validation: Inspected image: broad merged watercolor dabs, simplified pigment masses, varied edges, cool moonlit palette, inquisitive Australian Shepherd head only, elevated view over the den lip. Replaces rejected photorealistic v1.
